notes: Batch 6 «گوگل و عملکرد» (v1.11.65) — Groups 11+14 of the grouped audit. (1) L-PERF7: the first-pull merge no longer scans uid_map.values() linearly — a uid_set built once before the event loop makes the first pull ~0.008s in the merge loop (~0.025s total, was 0.258–0.307s). (2) L-PERF6 + PR6: every manual sync/push now has a 120 s client timeout (AbortSignal.timeout with an AbortController fallback) — the UI can no longer hang in «در حال همگام‌سازی» forever, and a timeout shows «تلاش دوباره»; server-side, a full push releases SYNC_LOCK between deletion chunks of 25 so a queued pull/push-one slips in instead of waiting out the whole push. (3) R5: the two nearly-identical update paths in _push_creates_updates are one helper (_push_update_one); this also fixed a real latent bug — the creates path referenced created_ids and prog_dirty as if they were globals (NameError, the whole push failed when a custom box's event was created). (4) R6: three pure helpers extracted from merge_calendar_events (_find_exact_matches, _find_deleted_match, _merge_would_orphan); the main loop is untouched. (5) ب-۷ — the three-state contract for async ops: the topbar sync button spins while running and a failed sync/save/backup-restore/update now says WHY (HTTP status / server error / «بیش از ۲ دقیقه») and offers a «تلاش دوباره» retry; success stays a short toast, backup-restore success is a toast instead of a native alert. (6) L-PERF3: /api/gemini-key and /api/gemini-model are cached with a 5 s TTL + in-flight dedupe (getGeminiKeyStatus / getGeminiModel, like getCalStatus) and invalidated on save — boot no longer hits them 4×/2×. (7) L-PERF5: the 60 s tick stops while the tab is hidden and refreshes once on return; a next-box reminder is never marked seen while hidden. (8) L-PERF4: renderAll now renders only the active tab (plus the always-visible topbar/sidebar); switching tabs re-renders the newly active one, so no tab can show stale — every tab was verified in jsdom; the real-browser timing check stays open (no real browser is available from the build environment). (9) C5/C7: dead functions removed — calSetMonth (app.js) and jalaliText (i18n.js, incl. its export entry); all display paths already used jalaliLabel. (10) C8: unused imports removed (secrets, SYNC_LOCK, merge_state, DEFAULT_STATE, AUTO_UPDATE_ACTIVE from server.py; import time from srv/backup.py; _with_lock from srv/google_sync.py) and the TestUnusedImports check is now strict real AST — a name mentioned only in a comment no longer counts as used (that was the loophole); the allowlist re-exports are untouched. (11) R8: the swallowing catches in refreshDataFromServer (now console.error + an error toast) and flushSavesBeacon (now console.error — a toast is invisible at pagehide) log instead of hiding failures; all other best-effort catches stay. R7 DEFERRED: the Handler class (~69 methods) is NOT split in this batch — the report itself says it is not mandatory and the extraction is a large, genuinely risky refactor on top of an already-large batch; it stays recorded for a later, dedicated pass. PR2 stays recorded-only (update-zip size caps read from the central directory; fixing needs an extraction-path rework). PR1 is NOT fixed here — the seq/ETag design is v1.11.67. (12) Release packaging fix (found while building this release): srv/telegram.py was missing from the release zip's file list AND from the updater's UPDATE_REQUIRED since 1.11.64 added it — server.py imports it unconditionally and install_update_zip wipes the app folder before extracting, so an in-app update from the release zip would have restarted into a broken tree; the same gap covered srv/backup.py, srv/repository.py and srv/google_sync.py, and all four are in both lists now, pinned by a test that checks every srv module server.py imports (the release zip is 22 entries now). i18n 1442/1442 (6 new keys: retryBtn, toastNotSavedReason, syncFailedReason, syncTimeout, bkRestoreFailedReason, refreshFailed).
